task_completion.description: Load both sample_points.geojson and sample_polygon.geojson into the QGIS Layers panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Layers panel shows 'sample_points' and 'sample_polygon' (or similar names) as active layers in the map project.

task_completion.description: Open the 'Join Attributes by Location' (Spatial Join) processing tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box titled 'Join Attributes by Location' or 'Spatial Join' is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Configure the tool with points as the base layer, polygons as the join layer, and select 'name' and 'area_sqkm' as the fields to add.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the tool dialog, 'sample_points' is selected as the Input Layer, 'sample_polygon' as the Join Layer, and the 'Fields to add' section lists 'name' and 'area_sqkm'.

task_completion.description: Run the spatial join process to create a temporary or permanent joined layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar completes, or a new layer (often named 'Joined layer') appears in the Layers panel.

task_completion.description: Open the attribute table of the joined layer to verify the presence of polygon data for the points.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An attribute table window is open showing columns for 'name' (e.g., Area A) and 'area_sqkm' (e.g., 10.5) alongside the point data.

task_completion.description: Export the final result to the specific path /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/points_with_polygon_info.geojson.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Layer As' or 'Export' dialog shows the file format as GeoJSON and the file path set to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/points_with_polygon_info.geojson.

integrity.description: The agent used the QGIS GUI to perform the spatial join rather than just running a python script or terminal command.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interaction with QGIS menus, processing toolboxes, and dialog windows.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the attribute values into a new file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the 'Join Attributes by Location' tool rather than manually editing attribute table cells.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the files located in /home/ga/GIS_Data/.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file browser or layer addition dialog shows the agent navigating to the /home/ga/GIS_Data/ directory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source point layer has 3 features (Point A, B, C). Point A and Point B should map to 'Area A' (area_sqkm: 10.5).
